report.summary: About 8% of UPI payments failed starting at 14:07 UTC due to a routing configuration update on upi-gateway (chg-9824) that incorrectly moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect. Because partner-bank-api did not have this endpoint available or ready, it returned 404 Not Found errors, resulting in route failures (U30) in upi-gateway and subsequent transaction failures in payments-api.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Routing Configuration Update Sent @okbank Traffic to Incorrect Endpoint

supporting.note: Config update at 14:06 moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect, immediately preceding the anomaly.
Error rate spiked starting at 14:07, right after the config change.
upi-gateway logged 404 Not Found from partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect starting at 14:07.
payments-api logged UPI collect failed due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 14:07.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Payments-API v2.15.0 Deploy Caused Request Formatting Incompatibility

supporting.note: payments-api v2.15.0 was deployed at 14:05, just before the incident.

contradicting.note: Error logs explicitly show partner-bank-api returning 404 Not Found on /v3/collect, indicating a downstream routing and endpoint issue rather than a client-side formatting bug.
The routing table update for @okbank explicitly targeted partner-bank-api /v3/collect precisely at 14:06, aligning with the 14:07 error onset.

facts.text: The error rate anomaly for payments-api began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, rising from a baseline under 0.4% to a peak of 8.89%.
The error rate anomaly for upi-gateway began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, rising from a baseline under 0.5% to a peak of 10.28%.
payments-api logged repeated errors stating 'UPI collect failed: upi-gateway error U30 (route failure)' starting at 14:07:07 UTC.
upi-gateway logged repeated errors stating 'partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect returned 404 Not Found for handle' starting at 14:07:03 UTC.
A deploy for payments-api (v2.15.0) occurred at 2026-10-07T14:05:00+00:00.
A routing table config update for upi-gateway moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect at 2026-10-07T14:06:00+00:00.

assumptions: partner-bank-api does not have /v3/collect deployed or active for @okbank handles.

timeline.event: upi-gateway routing table config updated to move @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect
Error rate spikes begin for both payments-api and upi-gateway
upi-gateway logs 404 Not Found from partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect
payments-api logs UPI collect failure due to upi-gateway error U30

recommended_actions.action: Revert the upi-gateway routing configuration change for @okbank handles back to /v2/collect or the correct active endpoint.
recommended_actions.rationale: The config change introduced at 14:06 directly triggered 404 errors and transaction failures on upi-gateway.

recommended_actions.action: Verify partner-bank-api endpoint availability and version compatibility before updating routing tables in future releases.
recommended_actions.rationale: Routing traffic to an unconfigured endpoint (/v3/collect) caused a complete failure for @okbank users.

recommended_actions.action: Implement pre-deployment checks or canary validation for gateway routing configuration updates.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents misconfigurations from propagating directly to production traffic without validation.
